Subject: MAP Weekly: POC Milestone Digest & Acceptance Path

Hi Sarah —

Following our kickoff last week, providing the first weekly digest for the MAP and the current acceptance path for the POC. Goal of this thread: preserve meeting notes, clearly call out acceptance criteria owners, and track blockers so we can hit the close milestones in the MAP.

Quick snapshot:
- Current MAP milestone: ingestion + sample inference (week of Apr 19)
- Eval plan: functional tests + latency/throughput smoke + quality spot checks against 5 canonical prompts
- Acceptance criteria (provisional): successful ingestion of 10k records, mean p95 latency < 800ms on the test harness, and >= 90% parity on quality checks vs baseline.

Open items (we need Helio input):
1) Confirmation of which dataset will be used for the 10k ingestion (CSV schema + retention window).
2) Any additional security evidence required for the POC (SOC2 artifacts already requested in the security questionnaire).
3) Preferred telemetry endpoints for us to push test metrics into your monitoring.

Can you confirm owners for (1) and (3) so we can finalize the eval runbook?

Attachments: I will attach the proposed eval tests spreadsheet after your confirmation (placeholder for now).

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart

Evelyn — thanks for the summary. Quick replies inline below.

> Quick snapshot:

> - Eval plan: functional tests + latency/throughput smoke + quality spot checks against 5 canonical prompts
> - Acceptance criteria (provisional): successful ingestion of 10k records, mean p95 latency < 800ms on the test harness, and >= 90% parity on quality checks vs baseline.

1) Dataset owner: Alex will own the ingestion file and will send the CSV schema by EOD Apr 21.
2) Security evidence: we reviewed the security questionnaire; Helio wants a short evidence bundle (SOC2 A-bridged + data flow diagram + encryption at rest confirmation). We can accept a summary PDF if that speeds the timeline.
3) Telemetry: Alex prefers a push to our S3 bucket (we'll share creds via secure transfer), but can accept a CloudWatch feed if Redwood recommends it.

Attachments: Alex attached a short telemetry requirements doc and a sample ingestion manifest.

We are targeting the internal acceptance review on Apr 28. If you can run the ingestion + smoke by Apr 24, we should be able to hit that internal review.

Thanks,
Sarah

Forwarding the call notes from today's sync with Helio (18 minutes). Key takeaways and owners below.

--- Meeting notes (short) ---
Attendees: Evelyn, Marissa, Karthik (Redwood); Sarah, Alex (Helio)
Agenda: ingestion manifest, telemetry, eval run schedule, acceptance gating

Decisions:
- Helio to deliver sample CSV + manifest by 2027-04-21 (Alex) — delivered 2027-04-20 (confirmed).
- Redwood will run ingestion on staging infra and execute the eval harness (Marissa lead).
- Telemetry: Helio will accept S3 uploads; Redwood to push aggregated metrics to shared S3 (Karthik to coordinate credential handoff).
- Acceptance review target: Helio internal review on 2027-04-28; joint acceptance window 2027-04-29–2027-04-30.

Action items (owners & status):
1) Marissa: finalize eval test spreadsheet, include the 5 canonical prompts, and mark pass/fail thresholds — due 2027-04-23 (IN PROGRESS). Attachment: Helio-Eval-Tests.xlsx
2) Karthik: create S3 bucket push script and share a runbook for credential exchange — due 2027-04-23 (IN PROGRESS).
3) Evelyn: compile the security evidence bundle summary (SOC2 + data flow) and send to Helio — due 2027-04-23 (PENDING).
4) Alex (Helio): confirm acceptance reviewer list and any extra criteria beyond the MAP — due 2027-04-21 (DONE).

Blockers:
- Small mismatch in CSV timestamp format which may affect ingestion parsing (Marissa/Helio to align).
- Karthik needs temporary S3 write credentials from Helio (security approval pending).

Notes on acceptance gating: if the ingestion run returns >2% failed records or p95 latency exceeds 1s, we flag as elevated risk and run a remediation cycle (expected 48–72 hrs).

Marissa (please update the spreadsheet with the timestamp format examples and toggle the expected pass/fail thresholds).

— Marissa

- Karthik is ready with the S3 push script; awaiting Helio temporary credentials (Alex).
- Evelyn: security bundle prepared and attached as a one-page summary.

Next steps / ask list:
1) Alex: please drop the S3 write creds into the secure transfer by EOD Apr 26 so we can run ingestion and the full eval on Apr 27.
2) Helio: prepare the internal acceptance reviewer list for Apr 28 and confirm any edge-case prompts to include in the quality check by EOD Apr 26.
3) Redwood: run ingestion + eval on Apr 27 and share the result artifact (POC-Logs-20270420.zip) and a short pass/fail summary by 10:00 PDT Apr 28.

If all go well, we are on track for the joint acceptance window on Apr 29–30. If you see any risk, call it out on this thread and we'll triage immediately.

Best,
